description: Several large plastic building blocks in green, blue, yellow, white, and purple are spread out on the bed in front of the hands. The left hand pulls a blue block toward the center while the right hand brings a green block in and aligns it, then the right hand slides another blue block from the far right and stacks the pieces into a tall column by placing yellow, then white, then green on top as the left hand steadies the stack; finally the left hand lifts the purple block and moves it toward the top as if to add it next.
